title: THE X-FILES
subtitle: skipto.tv
blurb: Eleven seasons in the FBI basement, charted season by season: the alien-conspiracy mythology split cleanly from the monsters of the week, Mulder's disappearance and the Doggett/Reyes years, the move from Vancouver to Los Angeles, and the 2016 and 2018 revivals.
regularsNote: Series regulars — Mulder, Scully, Skinner, and later Doggett and Reyes — aren't listed here; this dropdown covers the guest and recurring cast, which is where the Cigarette Smoking Man, Krycek, the Lone Gunmen, the informants and every monster of the week live.
chartHint: Eleven seasons across. Click any bar to filter the episode list; use the Mythology and Monster-of-the-week vibes to split the arc from the standalones. Mid-season events are drawn at season granularity with the exact episode in the label.
credits: Episode data, images and ratings from TVmaze. Mythology/standalone split follows Fox's X-Files Mythology DVD collections as marked on Wikipedia's season pages. Chart hand-built from the series.
